audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Shen at Levels 2, 3, First item and 2+ items; packet levelChart and the audited Aatrox mirror both give Skill, Skill, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Skill.
audit.why: The whys[] text already described Aatrox winning Levels 3 through first item, so the side tokens contradicted their own explanations and the mirror.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Skill; Level 3 through First item Aatrox; 2+ items Skill. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes already read Lvl 3 (Aatrox full kit), Lvl 6 Stand United, first item, two items — matching the mirror's spike record.
audit.corrected: Left as is; Stand United 200/180/160s and Shadow Dash 18s at rank 1 already carried in mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The knock-up was described as a vague 'sweetspot' with no cast tell, and Aatrox's healing (P, E passive, R) was never tied to Grievous Wounds in the trading text.
audit.why: Deathbringer Stance is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not an ability cast, is the tell. Aatrox heals off Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash's passive and World Ender, so extended trades are decided by anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now names Q3 as the knock-up and its 6s gap at rank 5; dontsFull[0].d names the passive auto-reset wind-up as the tell; breakdown.mid adds Bramble Vest against his P/E healing.

audit.why: The Darkin Blade is 14/12/10/8/6s; the existing text already trades on its spent window.

edits.before: Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep them. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Q3 is the knock-up. Sidestep that arc and step up in its 6s gap at rank 5.

edits.before: That is Aatrox's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His passive auto-reset wind-up is the tell — step back on that, not the Q cast.

edits.before: Trade strictly around The Darkin Blade: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around The Darkin Blade: when it is spent, run your full pattern; when up, give nothing. Buy Bramble Vest — his passive and E heal off you.

notes: Level chart flipped as one atomic group to match packet.levelChart and the audited aatrox mirror. Mirror note stands: World Ender's hardCC applies to minions only (fear), so it does not interrupt Stand United; the real interrupt Aatrox owns is the third Darkin Blade knock-up.
